articles.title: Supreme Court to review whether assault-weapons bans violate the Second Amendment
bullets: The court agreed to hear challenges to state assault-weapons restrictions.
The Trump administration argues the bans are unconstitutional.
The case could reshape gun regulations nationwide.

articles.title: Trump sticks to agenda after midterm rebuke
bullets: AP reports Trump is doubling down after Democratic midterm gains.
Democrats won majorities in both the House and Senate.
Analysts described the result as a broad national repudiation.

articles.title: Thanksgiving storms bring flooding, wind and widespread power outages
bullets: Heavy rain and winds hit much of the United States.
More than 900,000 customers lost power Thursday evening.
Trump signed a Florida disaster declaration after earlier flooding.

articles.title: Black Friday shoppers turn out despite inflation and bad weather
bullets: Shoppers visited malls and stores after Thanksgiving meals.
Some used AI tools to compare discounts and deals.
Mall of America reported stronger first-hour attendance than last year.

articles.title: US Air Force cloud breach prompts Cyber Command damage review
bullets: Reuters reported hackers breached the Air Force’s Cloud One platform.
US Cyber Command began assessing potential damage.
Application updates and migrations were reportedly halted.

articles.title: Zelenskyy urges US to pressure Putin over Ukraine war
bullets: Zelenskyy called for stronger US pressure on Putin.
He questioned Trump’s description of Putin as a “friend.”
The war is nearing its fifth year since Russia’s invasion.
articles.source: Associated Press summary via News Channel Nebraska

articles.title: US military says it disabled another ship trying to breach Mideast blockade
bullets: The US military reported another interdiction in the Mideast.
The ship was described as trying to breach a blockade.
The update came amid continuing regional tensions.
articles.source: Associated Press summary via News Channel Nebraska

articles.title: Former French Prime Minister Dominique de Villepin returns to politics
bullets: De Villepin is re-entering French politics at age 73.
He is seeking to block Marine Le Pen’s presidential path.
The move adds a new figure to France’s political contest.
articles.source: Associated Press summary via News Channel Nebraska

articles.title: EU leaders wrestle over long-term budget and Ukraine financing
bullets: EU leaders debated the bloc’s 2028–2034 budget proposal.
They also discussed future financing for Ukraine.
The seven-year budget requires unanimous approval from all 27 members.

articles.title: Strengthening El Niño brings early effects across regions
bullets: Time reported this El Niño is among the strongest on record.
Warm oceans are influencing weather and coastal conditions.
NOAA expects a wetter southern US winter in affected areas.

articles.title: Kharge calls INDIA bloc meeting on delimitation
bullets: Mallikarjun Kharge called a meeting of INDIA bloc parties.
Delimitation is listed as a key discussion issue.
Supriya Sule was reported likely to skip the meeting.

articles.title: Eight Andhra families rescued from alleged bonded labour in Telangana
bullets: The Indian Express reported the rescue in its live updates.
The families were from Andhra Pradesh.
Authorities treated the case as alleged bonded labour.

articles.title: Karthigai Deepam lit on Madurai hilltop under Supreme Court-appointed judges’ watch
bullets: The ceremonial lamp was lit on Thiruparankundram Hill.
Judges appointed by the Supreme Court oversaw the event.
CRPF security was reported around the site.

articles.title: WHO experts say India may miss 2026 measles elimination target
bullets: WHO experts warned India may miss its 2026 goal.
The concern persists despite high immunisation numbers.
The issue was flagged in Indian Express coverage.
articles.source: NEXT IAS citing The Indian Express

articles.title: Rahul Madan takes charge as IBBI chairperson
bullets: Rahul Madan took charge of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India.
The appointment took effect on November 25, 2026.
The update was attributed to an IBBI release.

articles.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow rally in shortened Friday session
bullets: The S&P 500 rose 1.60% on Friday.
The Nasdaq Composite gained 2.31%.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average climbed 1.18%.

articles.title: AI and chip stocks rebound after volatile week
bullets: AP said stocks jumped after erratic technology trading.
Reuters reported battered AI stocks gained into Friday’s close.
The rebound helped Wall Street post its best week in over a year.

articles.title: Vertex shares slide after FDA delay on kidney-drug decision
bullets: Vertex was listed among Friday’s largest notable decliners.
The move followed an FDA delay on a kidney-drug decision.
COT-Trading showed VRTX down more than 5%.

articles.title: SanDisk leads notable gainers in Friday’s US close
bullets: Swingfolio listed SNDK as a top Friday mover.
The stock was shown up 15.96%.
The gain came during a broader AI-and-chip rebound.

articles.title: Hershey appears among active US market movers
bullets: A MarkitDigital market report listed Hershey among active movers.
Hershey closed at 183.28 in the table.
The report showed a 3.81% day gain.

articles.title: Retailers see resilient Black Friday traffic despite higher prices
bullets: AP reported shoppers pursued deals despite inflation concerns.
NRF expected prices to drive about half of holiday sales growth.
Retail executives described consumers as surprisingly resilient.

articles.title: Jobs and sentiment data take focus for US economy-watchers
bullets: AP said upcoming reports will examine the economy from several angles.
Friday’s jobs report will detail November hiring.
Industry and consumer sentiment updates are also due.

articles.title: SpaceX secures $44 billion funding deal tied to Nvidia chip purchases
bullets: TechRadar cited Reuters reporting on a major SpaceX funding deal.
Senior secured notes mature in April 2033.
The financing is tied to Nvidia Vera Rubin chip purchases.

articles.title: Airbus satellite merger with Leonardo and Thales advances European space push
bullets: Axios cited Bloomberg on Airbus merging satellite operations.
Leonardo and Thales are part of the planned joint venture.
The venture would compete more directly with SpaceX.

articles.title: Atairos seeks sale of Ocean Outdoor, report says
bullets: Axios cited Reuters on a potential Ocean Outdoor sale.
The UK outdoor advertising operator could fetch about £800 million.
Atairos is reportedly exploring the transaction.

articles.title: AI math breakthroughs spark speculation about next scientific advances
bullets: Axios reported major math discoveries from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google.
The breakthroughs renewed debate over AI’s scientific capabilities.
Companies may be holding back additional results.

articles.title: FCC clears SpaceX plan for one million data centers in space
bullets: The Wall Street Journal front page reported the FCC clearance.
The approval was described as a major regulatory win.
The proposed scale could transform the night sky.

articles.title: US tightens scrutiny of AI-chip flows to China
bullets: Reuters-linked reports described expanded US chip-control enforcement.
Washington is deploying export-control officers to embassies.
The focus is preventing advanced AI chips from reaching China.

articles.title: Nvidia-linked Megaspeed faces renewed scrutiny over China exposure
bullets: Time examined red flags around Nvidia customer Megaspeed.
Congressional disclosures showed export-license requests involving advanced chips.
Megaspeed said it conducts lawful business and retained external counsel.

articles.title: US Air Force Cloud One breach adds to November technology-outage concerns
bullets: Reuters reported the Cloud One intrusion on November 27.
NBC also confirmed the breach, according to the current-events index.
The incident followed a month of high-profile technology disruptions.
articles.source: Reuters / NBC News via Wikipedia current-events index
